name: Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh
short_description: A 500-unit beachfront resort on Cam Ranh's 17-km Bai Dai beach, mixing sea-view rooms, studios and pool villas, about 10 minutes from Cam Ranh International Airport.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh is a large family resort directly on the 17-km Bai Dai beach in Cam Hai Dong, about 10 minutes from Cam Ranh International Airport and 30-40 km south of Nha Trang city. It has 500 units across three categories: 250 sea-view rooms and suites, 132 studio apartments with kitchenettes, and 118 pool villas, plus a 1,100 sqm destination spa with 23 treatment rooms and multiple restaurants and bars. Guest reviews consistently praise the amount of space, the beach, and family-oriented facilities including two kids' clubs, water slides and a rope park, with staff friendliness repeatedly highlighted. Some guests flag crowded breakfast service and buggy waits at peak times, and note that extras (spa, some dining) push costs above the room rate.

faqs.question: How many rooms and villas does Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh have?
faqs.answer: The resort has 500 units in total: 250 sea-view rooms and suites, 132 studio apartments with kitchenettes, and 118 pool villas. All categories offer direct sea views over Bai Dai beach from private balconies, and the resort is built around family-oriented facilities including two kids' clubs and a rope park.

faqs.question: How far is Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh from the airport?
faqs.answer: It's about 10 minutes by car from Cam Ranh International Airport, sitting directly on Cam Ranh's 17-km Bai Dai beach. Nha Trang city is roughly 30-40 km further north, so most guests treat this as a self-contained beach stay rather than a base for city exploring.
